GOLARION.Title: Golarion Map
GOLARION.SetHomeHint: Choose the party's location on the map. The current zoom is saved too.
GOLARION.PickPoint: Click the party's location on the map. Esc to cancel.
GOLARION.YearHint: Used when Calendaria is unavailable or calendar sync is disabled. The map shows the historical period containing this year.
GOLARION.CalendariaHint: Read the current year of Golarion from Calendaria, regardless of its active calendar. Calendaria is optional.
GOLARION.LoadFailed: The map could not load. Check that the module's map assets are installed and WebGL is available.
GOLARION.RememberHint: Save your personal camera and zoom between map openings. When disabled, the map opens at the party location.
GOLARION.ProjectionHint: Switch between the flat map and globe.
